# `stack.yaml` reference

<!-- Generated by "pnpm docs:generate" from packages/engine/src/config/schema.ts and the catalog. Do not edit. -->

`stack.yaml` describes the stack you want, and `mediaplane plan` and `apply` make the host match it. This page lists every field.

Editors can check the file as you type against its [JSON Schema](stack.schema.json). `mediaplane init` writes this first line for you:

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cyclopsgd/Mediaplane/main/docs/reference/stack.schema.json
```

A **secret reference** is `{ file: secrets/<name> }`, a file relative to the Mediaplane home, or `{ env: NAME }`, an environment variable. A secret itself never goes in `stack.yaml` ([ADR 0009](../adr/0009-no-secrets-in-stack-yaml.md)).

## Fields

| Field                   | Type                                    | Default                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `version`               | `1`                                     | required                  | The version of this file's format. Always 1.                                                                                                                                 |
| `timezone`              | string                                  | `"Etc/UTC"`               | The timezone the apps run in, as a tz database name such as Europe/London.                                                                                                   |
| `user`                  | object                                  | `{"uid":1000,"gid":1000}` | The user and group the apps run as. They must be able to write to paths.data.                                                                                                |
| `user.uid`              | integer, at least 0                     | required                  | The user id.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `user.gid`              | integer, at least 0                     | required                  | The group id.                                                                                                                                                                |
| `paths`                 | object                                  | required                  | Where your media lives.                                                                                                                                                      |
| `paths.data`            | string                                  | required                  | The data folder for downloads and media, mounted in the apps as /data. Keep both on one filesystem inside it, so moves are instant hardlinks. An absolute path, without ":". |
| `network`               | object                                  | `{"bind":"lan"}`          | Where the web UIs are published.                                                                                                                                             |
| `network.bind`          | one of `lan`, `localhost`, `all`        | `"lan"`                   | lan: on this host's private (RFC 1918) addresses. localhost: on 127.0.0.1 only. all: on every interface, and plan warns every time. On a cloud VM, lan needs lan_subnet.     |
| `network.lan_subnet`    | string                                  |                           | Your LAN as an IPv4 CIDR, such as 192.168.1.0/24. Detected from this host's private addresses when left out; on a cloud VM, bind: lan needs it set.                          |
| `security`              | object                                  | `{"login_on_lan":true}`   | Login settings.                                                                                                                                                              |
| `security.login_on_lan` | boolean                                 | `true`                    | Ask for a login from your own network too. false lets Sonarr, Radarr and Prowlarr skip it for addresses in the LAN subnet.                                                   |
| `admin`                 | object                                  | `{"username":"admin"}`    | The shared admin login for the apps that have one. Not used yet: the apps' logins are set up from Slice 3.                                                                   |
| `admin.username`        | string                                  | `"admin"`                 | The admin user name. Not used yet (Slice 3).                                                                                                                                 |
| `admin.password`        | secret reference                        |                           | The admin password, as a secret reference. Checked to exist, but not used yet: from Slice 3, a password is generated when this is left out.                                  |
| `media_server`          | one of `jellyfin`, `plex`               | required                  | The media server, jellyfin or plex. It runs whether or not it is listed under apps.                                                                                          |
| `plex`                  | object                                  |                           | Plex settings, needed when media_server is plex.                                                                                                                             |
| `plex.token`            | secret reference                        | required                  | Your Plex token, as a secret reference. Checked to exist, but not used yet: claiming the server arrives in Slice 6.                                                          |
| `vpn`                   | object                                  |                           | The VPN that qBittorrent's traffic goes through, by way of Gluetun. Needed while apps.qbittorrent.vpn is true.                                                               |
| `vpn.provider`          | string                                  | required                  | The VPN provider, by its Gluetun name, such as mullvad.                                                                                                                      |
| `vpn.private_key`       | secret reference                        | required                  | Your WireGuard private key, as a secret reference.                                                                                                                           |
| `vpn.addresses`         | string                                  |                           | The WireGuard address, for providers that need one, such as Mullvad. Other Gluetun settings go in apps.gluetun.env.                                                          |
| `apps`                  | object                                  | `{}`                      | The apps to run, by id. Listing an app runs it, even with no settings.                                                                                                       |
| `overrides`             | map of name → string, number or boolean | `{}`                      | Keep mine values, by \<app>.\<resource>.\<field>. Not used yet: drift detection arrives in Slice 4.                                                                          |
| `managed_by`            | one of `mediaplane`, `external`         | `"mediaplane"`            | external: Mediaplane never writes this file, for when automation such as Ansible owns it. Today only init writes it, and init never overwrites. Matters from Slice 4.        |

## Settings every app takes

Under `apps.<app>`, where `<app>` is one of the apps listed at the end of this page.

| Field                | Type                                     | Default | Description                                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `apps.<app>.enabled` | boolean                                  | `true`  | Turn the app off but keep its settings with false. Listing an app turns it on.                                                                  |
| `apps.<app>.port`    | integer, 1 to 65535                      |         | The host port the app's web UI is published on. The port inside the container stays the same, except for qBittorrent, where both move together. |
| `apps.<app>.version` | string                                   |         | Run this image tag instead of the tested one. plan warns that it is an untested combination.                                                    |
| `apps.<app>.env`     | map of name → string or secret reference | `{}`    | Extra environment variables for the app: strings, or secret references, which never appear in compose.yaml.                                     |

## One app's own settings

| Field                       | Type    | Default | Description                                                                                                                                    |
| --------------------------- | ------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `apps.qbittorrent.vpn`      | boolean | `true`  | Route qBittorrent through Gluetun's VPN, so it has no network when the VPN is down. true needs a vpn: block; false makes plan warn every time. |
| `apps.seerr.sonarr_profile` | string  |         | The Sonarr quality profile Seerr requests with. Not used yet (Slice 7).                                                                        |
| `apps.seerr.radarr_profile` | string  |         | The Radarr quality profile Seerr requests with. Not used yet (Slice 7).                                                                        |
